Remark
[Weak solutions of the transport equation] 1. ch2:2.1.1-rem-1\group Transport Equation For nonsmooth, even discontinuous, initial data $g$, the same formula $u(x,t)=g(x-tb)$ defines the natural weak transport solution, although it need not be $C^1$.
